description: aree circolazione pedonali is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. Management of pedestrian circulation areas. Pedestrian area; it includes all sections of the road platform that, within the urban areas, are reserved for pedestrian transit (walking, pedestrian passage or parking, lifebuoys, etc.). This class does not include the road area that has become pedestrian (e.g. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "pedestrian circulation areas" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
